article.title: Sherrod Brown: Vote out Chuck Schumer!
article.author: Columbus DSA
article.content: A joint statement from the following Ohio DSA Chapters: Akron, Cleveland, Columbus, Dayton-Miami Valley, Mahoning Valley, Metro Cincinnati & Northern Kentucky, Wooster, Bowling Green O.C., Wheeling O.C. These Ohio Chapters of the Democratic Socialists of America (DSA) endorse the campaign led by the DSA National Electoral Commission (NEC) to Say No to Chuck Schumer as Senate Majority Leader . During his nearly three decades as a US Senator, Chuck Schumer has consistently advanced the interests of corporate power at home and imperialism abroad against the interests of working people. Under Obama, Schumer was among the few Democratic Senators to cross party lines and vote against the negotiated agreement between the United States and Iran. Serving during the Biden administration as Majority Leader, Schumer failed to codify Roe v. Wade into law, setting the stage for its overturning by the Supreme Court. Moreover, he failed to deliver meaningful legislation on important issues such as voting rights, worker rights, and climate change. Schumer participated in fearmongering against our immigrant neighbors and attempted to expand militant border security. Meanwhile, he has pledged that his top priority is to ensure the Democrats remain steadfast in their support of Israeli apartheid – despite the ongoing genocide in Gaza – and has received $1.7 million from pro-Israel groups since 1990, according to Open Secrets . As Minority Leader under the second Trump administration, Schumer has not used the congressional war powers to stop illegal wars abroad. Schumer has no intention of abolishing ICE – a moral imperative and the majority opinion of workers across the country. When Democrats used their leverage to force a historic government shutdown to preserve healthcare subsidies under the Affordable Care Act, Schumer capitulated – leading to dramatically increased costs for working people. The people have overwhelmingly demanded change while Chuck Schumer personifies complacency, cowardice, and corruption. If the Senate Democratic Caucus doesn’t take this opportunity to look toward new leadership and follow through on their promises to their constituents, then they would prove yet again that they do not represent the working class. We call on Sherrod Brown to vote against Chuck Schumer for Majority Leader because Workers Deserve More. Send a letter to Sherrod Brown telling him to “chuck Chuck” here .
